stemMd: A student argues that a bus service should run on Sundays because many hospital workers have Sunday shifts and no other public route reaches the hospital. Which assumption links the premises to the proposal?

options.label: A
options.textMd: No one ever travels for any reason other than work.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every hospital worker owns three cars.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Sunday buses must be faster than trains in all cities.

options.label: E
options.textMd: At least some of those workers need or would use public transport on Sundays.

explanationMd: The premises establish Sunday work and lack of another route. To justify this bus service on that basis, some affected workers must have a relevant transport need or use. The argument does not require every worker to use it.

distractorRationale.c: That would not support the transport need.
distractorRationale.b: This contradicts the stated Sunday shifts.
distractorRationale.d: The argument does not require this universal comparison.
distractorRationale.a: The proposal does not depend on excluding other travel purposes.
